findings.summary: Cross-validation uses StratifiedKFold, which splits by visit and ignores patient_id, so the same patient can appear in both train and test folds, causing data leakage and an inflated PR-AUC; it should use StratifiedGroupKFold with groups=df["patient_id"] passed to cv.split.

judge.reason: Identifies row-level StratifiedKFold leaking patients across folds and proposes StratifiedGroupKFold by patient_id, same as b1.

findings.label: hit
